en.html:
Exactly why I also had refrained from leaving the quarters. By day, inquiries were possible. Go investigating at night and merely being seen could create fatal suspicion. Nothing to be gained there.

Even Muramasa, so skilled at remaining unseen, was struggling with this surveillance. Slip through it and gather intelligence? For a counterfeit policeman, that was a little too much excellence to expect.

en.html:
Two purposes had brought me to Fudaraku.

One was the Prince's command.
The other—the dying words of Nikkari.

　　　　　　　　《The silver... star...》

　　　　　　　　《That princess...》

　　　　　　　　《............Rokuhara's............》

Rokuhara's what? What had he been about to say?

No way of finding out. The dead were not going to answer.

But if the Silver Star had some connection with Rokuhara, this mountain fortress of Fudaraku was the first place to investigate. The shogunate's brain and heart, both here.

In that respect, the Prince's request had arrived exactly when a way across was needed.

ja.html:
俺が普陀楽へやってきた目的は二つ。

　一つは親王の下命。
　もう一つは――<ruby>青江<rt>ニッカリ</rt></ruby>の遺言。

　
　　　　　　　　　《白銀の星》

　
　　　　　　　　　《かの姫は》

　
　　　　　　　　　《六波羅の》

　六波羅の――何だと言おうとしたのか。
　それは知る術とてない。死人は語ってくれない。

　だが銀星号が六波羅に関わり有りとするなら、まず
調べるべきはこの普陀楽山塞だ。
　幕府の頭脳であり心臓。

　その意味で、親王の依頼は渡りに船でもあった。

en.html:
No answer.

Her presence moved away.

Physical distance, that was all. I knew it. Still, I could not help feeling something else in the growing distance: how far Muramasa was withdrawing from me.

Ever since I decided to follow Ichijou, it had been like this.

Muramasa was going farther away.

　村正は俺から遠ざかっている。

Now, this very moment, I could feel those cold steel eyes on my skin.

The desire to kill me... to kill evil... was still there. It had not gone anywhere.
